# Valstara

> Valstara is preparing a storefront for digital goods. This site hosts the pre-launch waitlist and publishes information about the company, its commitments, and the launch giveaway.

## About Valstara

- [About Valstara](https://valstara.com/about): What Valstara sells, how it works, and who runs it.
- [Who runs Valstara](https://valstara.com/legit): Company details, contact information, and ways to check the company independently.
- [The Triple Guarantee](https://valstara.com/guarantee): The commitments Valstara makes for store orders. The store is not open yet.

## Waitlist and giveaway

- [Launch giveaway rules](https://valstara.com/giveaway/rules): The current rules for the global launch giveaway.
- [Waitlist terms](https://valstara.com/terms): Terms for joining and using the pre-launch waitlist.

## Privacy

- [Privacy notice](https://valstara.com/privacy): How the pre-launch site handles personal data.
- [Cookie and storage inventory](https://valstara.com/privacy/storage): The site's browser storage and cookie inventory.

## Contact

For questions about Valstara, the waitlist, or the giveaway, contact support@valstara.com.
